title: The AI Factory, Part 1: A Ground-Up Look at Everything That Powers Artificial Intelligence
excerpt: Behind every AI response is a factory the size of city blocks, drawing electricity like a small town, cooled by Olympic swimming pools' worth of water. This is Part 1 of a series breaking down every layer of the AI infrastructure stack — from silicon and compound semiconductors to copper, photonics, cooling, and the power grid.

title: Jensen's Moment: What the GTC 2026 Keynote Tells Us About the Next Phase of AI
excerpt: Jensen Huang called it the Inference Inflection. GTC 2026 wasn't just a product launch — it was a declaration that the AI race has shifted from training the biggest model to deploying AI everywhere, all the time, at a cost that makes it economically viable.

title: The Fiber Backbone of AI: Why Optical Infrastructure Is the Sleeper Trade of the Decade
excerpt: Everyone knows the AI story — Nvidia prints money, hyperscalers spend hundreds of billions, data centers multiply like rabbits. But beneath all that compute lies a quieter revolution that a sharp group of investors began flagging years before it became consensus: the optical buildout.
